# Masuyo Digital

> Websites, marketing and software for growing businesses across the UK.
> Prices are published up front. One senior person builds each project, with
> trusted specialists brought in when a job needs them.

## Guides

- [How much does a website cost in the UK?](https://masuyodigital.com/guides/website-cost-uk): Real UK price bands, what drives the cost, and the ongoing fees most quotes leave out.
- [What should a small business website include?](https://masuyodigital.com/guides/small-business-website-checklist): The pages, features and technical basics every small business site needs, and what to skip.
- [Next.js vs WordPress for small business websites](https://masuyodigital.com/guides/nextjs-vs-wordpress): Speed, cost, maintenance and editing compared, and when each is the right call.
- [How to brief a web design agency](https://masuyodigital.com/guides/how-to-brief-a-web-design-agency): A structure for the brief, and the red flags to watch for in responses.
- [What is a website care plan, and do you need one?](https://masuyodigital.com/guides/website-care-plans): What maintenance covers, what it costs, and how to spot hosting sold as service.
- [Website design for community interest companies](https://masuyodigital.com/guides/website-design-for-cics): What a CIC site must do differently, how to fund it, and what it should cost.
- [How to get more enquiries from your website](https://masuyodigital.com/guides/more-enquiries-from-your-website): Conversion fixes ordered by impact relative to effort.
